static_traits.name: Liu Kexin
static_traits.social_status: Close to family, receiving support, but feeling uneasy discussing Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to specifically describe experiences and thoughts, good cooperation, tone containing Self-doubt

basic_info.main_problem: I believe 'becoming an excellent Dancer' is the only thing I am good at, this belief making me feel limited and Self-doubting when trying other interests or skills, and hurting my self-esteem and confidence in exploring new things.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to no longer be bound by this limiting belief, able to explore and develop interests and skills beyond dance, change mindset, boost confidence and motivation.
growth_experiences: Being criticized for spelling ability in High school, under moderate stress at the time gradually formed the self-belief of 'besides dancing I am good for nothing'; this belief has persisted since High school, gradually affecting self-esteem and confidence, making her feel limited and inclined to give up when exploring talents or skills beyond dance.

core_beliefs: Besides dancing I am good for nothing
In other areas I am destined to fail

special_situations.event: Being criticized for spelling ability in High school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly in academics or language ability, it means I have no value or ability beyond dance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-binds self-worth to dance performance, reducing attempts in other areas
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Besides dancing, I am no good in other areas

special_situations.event: Participating in a painting course last year to try a new skill
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot excel quickly, it proves I am not suited for this field
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: To avoid failure or embarrassment, quickly gives up new activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never learn painting well, continuing is just a waste of time

special_situations.event: When discussing Self-doubt with family, family mostly comforts with 'you dance very well'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others only recognize my dancing, it means I have no value in other areas
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding in-depth discussion of own limitations with family, Reinforcement the single identity of dance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They only see that I can dance, I cannot do other things well

special_situations.event: Trying to explore careers or skills beyond dance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing to reach high standards equals failure, proving I am only suited for dancing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces involvement and withdraws early to avoid facing possible failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can only dance, trying other things has no meaning

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and recognized as a multifaceted and capable person, able to freely explore and be accepted
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and criticism, worrying about being seen as 'good for nothing besides dancing' and feeling ashamed
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated and maintaining security by tying self-worth to dance and avoiding new fields

object_relations.self_representation: Confined to a self of a single talent, a self prone to failure in non-dance fields

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to try new activities or proposed an action plan to explore beyond dance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously treats challenges as having to 'perform perfectly' immediately, otherwise it is failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declining or brushing off with reasons like 'this is just a waste of time' 'I am not suited', rational tone, low emotional intensity, avoiding further discussion of details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking of discussing Self-doubt with family or seeking understanding
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the family will think they are 'overthinking / being silly', and will only emphasize dance results while ignoring the real distress
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Presetting negative reactions and choosing avoidance or Displacement of topics, hesitant tone, reducing self-disclosure.

manifestations: Uses self-limiting beliefs to fix identity as 'only dance has value'
Avoids trying new things, reduces choices and possibilities
Feeling 'meaningless' 'just a waste of time' when trying new things
Finds it hard to get excited about activities other than dance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizing High school spelling criticism into global self-evaluation without digesting it
Forming and maintaining the belief of 'besides dancing I am good for nothing'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When trying new activities, frequently self-blames (such as 'just a waste of time')
Worries too much about failure, gives up new activities too early

positive_force: Family support resources are good (family care and encouragement)
Performs excellently in dance, showing perseverance and training ability
Has proactively tried new activities (such as painting), showing willingness to explore
Willing to seek help and start counseling
negative_force: The core limiting belief of 'besides dancing I am no good'
Fear of failure and perfectionistic tendencies lead to giving up early
Strong mental filtering and negating-the-positive tendency, prone to Self-denial
Biased toward external approval; hard to evaluate his own ability internally

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or quickly gives up new activities other than dance
antecedent: When trying new skills or exploring other careers
When thinking of discussing Self-doubt with family
Recalling the experience of Being criticized for spelling in High school
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralized beliefs formed after being criticized in High school and Fear of failure, accompanied by underestimation of own ability
target_behavior.function: Avoids possible failure and shame, maintaining self-consistency and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Decreased drive, limited exploration, hindered Career development
